text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in the cafeteria, I spotted 
Symboli Rudolf surrounded by a massive 
spread of food.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-kun. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite a magnificent sight, isn't it? 
These are the new dishes created by the 
chef here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone working at Tracen Academy 
constantly puts their heart into providing 
us with a better life.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria menu overhaul is part of 
that. ...I really take my hat off to them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As someone who cares just as deeply for 
the students, I will spare no effort to 
help!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I volunteered to be the taste 
tester, you see.
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too much food?
Isn't that a bit too much food?
Alright, let's do a proper taste test!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I volunteered to be the taste 
tester, you see.
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too much food?
Isn't that a bit too much food?
Alright, let's do a proper taste test!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It is indeed a testament to the chefs' 
spirit, but well, fair enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I cannot go back on something I 
have accepted once. What should I do—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's how it was, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Someone who cared about an Umamusume more 
than anything else was right here beside 
me all along.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective— I would definitely 
like to hear your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us work together to help make this a 
better cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them thoroughly 
savored their food together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! There is quite a variety, and 
several high-calorie dishes among them, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy students are all hearty 
eaters. I shall certainly do my part to 
help develop a menu that can satisfy even 
their appetites!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first up is that "Giant Bowl of 
Shrimp Cream Pasta"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her perpetually hungry 
students, Symboli Rudolf resolved to push 
her stomach to its absolute limit.
